value_range.description: Shape [2] `Tensor` of same `dtype` as `values`. values <= value_range[0] will be mapped to hist[0], values >= value_range[1] will be mapped to hist[-1].

nbins.description: Scalar `int32 Tensor`. Number of histogram bins.

constraints: If any unsupported dtype is provided, TypeError will be raised.

output.description: A `Tensor` holding the indices of the binned values whose shape matches `values`.

constraints: name is optional unless explicitly required in the signature
